title: Short-circuit Compose budget preflight
finding: The Compose budget preflight computed the complete operation count with sum(...) before comparing it to the remaining plan-wide budget. A plan that exceeded its budget on the first middle row could therefore continue scanning every later left CSR entry even though refusal was already inevitable.
primary_claim: ReferenceContractionInterpreter now accumulates exact Compose work incrementally and refuses immediately when the remaining plan-wide operation budget is exceeded. It does not scan later left column indices or enter TypedRelationBlock.matmul after the budget is already exhausted; exact inclusive-budget behavior is unchanged.
gardener_decision: Replace the eager aggregate sum with the same bounded incremental accounting shape already used by the Hadamard preflight. Do not add a planner, cost-model object, cache, alternate executor, or public API. Keep the existing relation-block operation guard as defense in depth.
acceptance: a Compose whose first referenced right row already exceeds the remaining budget refuses before requesting any later left column index
TypedRelationBlock.matmul is not invoked after the Compose preflight budget is exhausted
compatible Compose execution at the exact inclusive budget remains unchanged
same-subject/semiring and exact middle-axis checks still precede cost scanning
no OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created

requested: bounded Tensor/Forest diagnostic on the designated Python 3.12 hash-seed 0 cell
verification.claim: Only exact-head executed workflow steps count as evidence.

rollback: Revert the G1-TENSOR-01BB commits; Forest/Fourfold authority, relation-block wire contracts, semiring semantics and persisted identities are unchanged.
